marketSummary: Indian benchmark indices witnessed severe selling pressure on October 8, 2026, with the Nifty 50 plunging 1.64% (371 points) to close at 22,231.80 and the BSE Sensex dropping 1,045 points to 71,593.24. Sentiment was weighed down by the Reserve Bank of India's surprise 25 bps repo rate hike to 5.50% and stance shift to 'calibrated tightening', compounding worries over Brent crude spiking past $103–$104 per barrel amid West Asia conflict escalations. Heavy foreign institutional investor (FII) outflows continued unabated, triggering broad-based liquidation across rate-sensitive sectors, metals, and capital goods, while select retail and IT counters showed defensive posturing ahead of quarterly earnings.
dailyFocus: In light of aggressive distribution in the benchmark indices and multi-month breakdown prints across cyclical baskets, swing traders must practice capital preservation. Focus shifts from aggressive momentum continuation to defensive post-earnings reactions (e.g., TCS Q2 results), resilient retail updates (Trent), and supply-chain de-bottlenecking catalysts in aerospace/defence (HAL, BEL) once index volatility subsides.

news.headline: Honeywell accelerates TPE331 engine deliveries for HAL's HTT-40 trainer aircraft
news.summary: Honeywell Aerospace confirmed on October 8, 2026, that it is expediting engine supplies for HAL's HTT-40 basic trainer aircraft, committing to deliver 8 engines by end-2026 and another 8 by mid-2027 (total 16 engines), approximately two years ahead of the original 2029 schedule. This unblocks production delays at HAL's Bengaluru and Nashik facilities.
news.impact: Resolves a critical execution bottleneck, enhancing manufacturing visibility and providing support at the base retest level.

news.headline: TCS kicks off Q2 FY27 earnings with 15% net profit growth and ₹12 interim dividend
news.summary: Tata Consultancy Services reported consolidated Q2 FY27 net profit of ₹13,884 crore (up 15% YoY) on revenue of ₹73,188 crore (up 11.2% YoY, up 0.5% QoQ in constant currency). Total Contract Value (TCV) stood at $9.6 billion, while annualized AI revenues crossed $3.1 billion (surpassing 10% of total revenue). The board declared a second interim dividend of ₹12 per share with record date October 14, 2026.
news.impact: Steady operating margin at 24.0% and AI deal conversion provide defensive ballast and could support IT index consolidation patterns.

news.headline: Dalal Street sell-off deepens as Nifty hits fresh low on $104 crude and relentless FII exits
news.summary: The Nifty 50 crashed 371.25 points (1.64%) on October 8, 2026, closing at 22,231.80, while the BSE Sensex plummeted 1,045 points to 71,593.24. Brent crude breached $104 per barrel following escalations and shipping disruptions in the Gulf, while foreign institutional investors recorded net outflows of nearly ₹47,000 crore ($4.86 billion) across the past nine sessions.
news.impact: Invalidates short-term multi-week base breakouts across index large caps; swing traders must tighten stops and favor cash.

news.headline: GE Aerospace delivers four F404 engines for LCA Tejas Mk-1A to HAL as shipments stabilize
news.summary: GE Aerospace announced the delivery of four F404-IN20 engine shipsets to Hindustan Aeronautics Limited, bringing shipments to seven engines over the past two months against the 99-engine order. HAL has 25 Tejas Mk-1A airframes ready awaiting powerplants, and GE expects to ramp up deliveries past 20 engines annually from 2027.
news.impact: Direct operational de-bottlenecking catalyst that stabilizes price action after recent defense PSU retracements.

news.headline: RBI MPC raises repo rate by 25 bps to 5.50%, shifts stance to calibrated tightening
news.summary: On October 7, 2026, the RBI Monetary Policy Committee voted unanimously to increase the policy repo rate by 25 bps from 5.25% to 5.50% and shifted its stance from neutral to calibrated tightening. Governor Sanjay Malhotra cited resurging global crude prices, geopolitical volatility in West Asia, and inflation pressures, projecting FY27 CPI inflation at 5.2% and real GDP growth at 7.1%.
news.impact: Triggers multi-day multiple compression and overhead resistance for rate-sensitive swing setups across Banking, Realty, and Auto.

news.headline: Trent rallies over 10% after Q2 standalone revenue jumps 23% YoY to ₹5,788 crore
news.summary: Trent Limited delivered a standout Q2 FY27 business update, reporting standalone revenue from operations of ₹5,788 crore, a 23% YoY increase, while H1 FY27 revenue rose 21% to ₹11,454 crore. The retailer reached a milestone with its 1,000th Zudio store, expanding the total store footprint to 1,342 outlets as of September 30, 2026.
news.impact: Massive high-volume range breakout defying broader market weakness; sets up continuation plays above the ₹2,800 consolidation shelf.

news.headline: CG Power consolidates near ₹895 after Transformer VP resigns to join Siemens Energy
news.summary: Shares of CG Power and Industrial Solutions fell 1.9% to ₹894.50 following the disclosure that Ajay Jain, Vice President of the Transformer Business, resigned effective September 30, 2026 (subsequently appointed head of transformers at Siemens Energy India). The stock's pullback comes as its Sanand OSAT semiconductor joint venture targets a phased capacity ramp-up.
news.impact: Key divisional leadership departure triggers mild base consolidation around the ₹880–₹900 zone; await volume contraction before fresh entry.

news.headline: BEL closes trading window ahead of Q2 FY27 results after bagging cumulative ₹648 crore orders
news.summary: Bharat Electronics Limited notified exchanges that its trading window closed effective October 1, 2026, ahead of its Q2 FY27 financial results. The announcement follows BEL's recent order intake of ₹648 crore spanning IR jammers and AI defense software, keeping its total order book solid above ₹73,800 crore.
news.impact: Healthy order pipeline cushions downside; price is forming a multi-week consolidation range around ₹370–₹385 ahead of Q2 earnings.

news.headline: Cochin Shipyard acquires 23% equity in Dutch ship designer Conoship for €2.3 million
news.summary: Cochin Shipyard has entered into a Share Purchase Agreement to acquire a 23% stake in Netherlands-based Conoship International Holding B.V. for €2.30 million (~₹25.10 crore) after receiving DIPAM clearance. The strategic partnership targets European short-sea and inland green shipping vessels powered by alternative fuels (methanol/hydrogen).
news.impact: Expands high-margin green design capability into Europe, but near-term swing setup remains vulnerable to broader PSU liquidation.

news.headline: Four stocks placed under NSE F&O ban on October 8 amid heightened expiry volatility
news.summary: The National Stock Exchange placed Ambuja Cements, Bandhan Bank, LIC Housing Finance, and Steel Authority of India (SAIL) under the futures and options trading ban for October 8, 2026, after their derivative open interest crossed 95% of the market-wide position limit (MWPL).
news.impact: Forces leverage unwinding and curtails speculative momentum in banned counters during intraday expiry sessions.
